title: Allay girl
description: Add a cute model of a feminine alley.
body:
A cute female redesign for the Allay!

Transform the Allay into a beautifully redesigned female companion with a custom 3D model and detailed textures. Designed to fit naturally within Minecraft's vanilla style, this resource pack adds a fresh and elegant look while keeping all of the Allay's original functionality.

This resource pack requires support for Custom Entity Models (CEM). You can use a compatible version of OptiFine, or install the Entity Texture Features (ETF) and Entity Model Features (EMF) mods to ensure the custom model and textures work correctly.
